description: 2023年2月6日発生のトルコ大地震 [earthquakes] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by アジア航測株式会社. このたびのトルコ大地震で被害に合われた方々に心よりお見舞いを申し上げます。 2023年2月6日のトルコ南部の地震は、プレート境界にある東アナトリア断層で発生しました。 トルコ南部のシリア国境近くのこの地域では、過去にも地震が起きていますが、今回はM7. 8の地震と9時間後のM7. 5の地震の連続発生だったので、トル... Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher アジア航測株式会社. Its tags are トルコ, 地震, 赤色立体地図. It offers 2 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2024-10-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
